name: Eye morphogenesis with photoreceptor and retinal neuron development
rationale: Nearly all members concern eye structures (retina, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, lacrimal gland, ocular vessels and barriers); retinal neuron and photoreceptor differentiation separates it from the inner-ear/sensory-organ and phototransduction/retinoid neighbours.

name: Appetite and feeding regulation by leptin and ghrelin
rationale: Members regulate eating, food response, nutrient-level responses and body growth through leptin and ghrelin, unlike neighbours built on gut-hormone GPCRs or growth hormone receptor signaling.

name: Angiotensin signaling and vascular blood pressure control
rationale: All members concern renin-angiotensin control of systemic and pulmonary blood pressure and vasoconstriction, whereas neighbours emphasise renal sodium/urine handling, natriuretic cGMP and angiotensin peptide metabolism.

name: Integrin-syndecan adhesion turnover in substrate-dependent cell migration
rationale: Members cover integrin and syndecan substrate adhesion, spreading and migration, with focal adhesion disassembly and invadopodia distinguishing it from neighbours centred on MET-PTK2, fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion assembly.

qualifier: TRAF-mediated interferon induction and viral evasion
name: RIG-I-like receptor TRAF-mediated interferon induction and viral evasion
rationale: Members describe RLR (RIG-I/MDA5) signaling through TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF and NF-kB and type I interferon, plus viral modulation of it, unlike neighbours focused on cytosolic DNA sensing, dsRNA response and IRF3/OAS effectors.

name: Mitochondrial heme, iron-sulfur cluster and ubiquinone biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover heme/porphyrin synthesis, Fe-S cluster assembly with ferredoxin electron supply, and quinone synthesis, distinct from neighbours on erythrocyte gas/iron transport and respiratory complex assembly.

qualifier: meiosis, gonadal hormones, fertilization and zygotic activation
name: Gametogenesis, meiosis, gonadal hormones, fertilization and zygotic activation
rationale: Members span germ cell specification, meiosis, sperm and oocyte development, gonadotropin/sex-steroid control, fertilization and maternal-to-zygotic transition, distinguishing it from mitotic cell-cycle and placental/trophoblast neighbours.

name: E2F-driven G1/S replication origin licensing and initiation
rationale: Members concern E2F target transcription and pre-replicative complex assembly and replication initiation at G1/S, unlike neighbours that add E2F6 regulation, G2/M transition or intra-S damage checkpoints.

name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst regulation
rationale: Members centre on superoxide generation and respiratory burst by phagocyte NADPH oxidase in macrophages and neutrophils, distinct from neighbours on bacterial killing, degranulation and antifungal responses.

name: Serotonin and histamine synthesis, transport and receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern serotonin or histamine biosynthesis, uptake, secretion and receptor signaling, unlike neighbours built on muscarinic acetylcholine and tachykinin receptors.

qualifier: NMDA and AMPA receptor activation and assembly
name: NMDA and AMPA glutamate receptor activation and trafficking
rationale: Members describe NMDA and AMPA receptor assembly, activation and downstream signaling in long-term potentiation, distinct from neighbours on dendritic spine structural plasticity and CaMK-CREB nuclear signaling.

name: Base excision repair AP-site resolution and OGG1/MUTYH defects
rationale: Members cover downstream BER steps (AP-site processing, short- and long-patch gap filling) and defective OGG1/MUTYH glycosylases, unlike neighbours on damaged-base recognition, NEIL/NTHL1 defects and mitochondrial DNA repair.

name: NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxic activation
rationale: Members are NK and T cell signatures and positive regulation of NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxicity and proliferation, distinct from neighbours on MHC class Ib presentation, KIR receptors, inhibition and tolerance.

name: Meiotic metaphase-to-anaphase chromosome alignment and segregation
rationale: All members concern meiotic chromosome alignment, separation control and movement to spindle poles, unlike neighbours on meiotic recombination, cohesion establishment and meiosis I entry.

qualifier: branched-chain amino acid catabolism and cofactors
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism and branched-chain amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial acyl-CoA flux: BCAA/lysine catabolism and its disorders, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases with lipoate/biotin/CoA cofactors, ketone bodies and short-chain beta-oxidation, unlike carnitine/long-chain fatty acid and malate-aspartate shuttle neighbours.

name: Tryptophan catabolism via kynurenine to NAD+
rationale: All members describe the tryptophan-kynurenine-quinolinate pathway to de novo NAD+, distinct from neighbours on other amino acid catabolism and NAD+ salvage.

qualifier: distal cholesterol synthesis and inherited P450 enzyme defects
name: Distal cholesterol biosynthesis and inherited P450 lipid-enzyme defects
rationale: Members are post-zymosterol cholesterol synthesis routes plus inherited defects of P450 and related lipid/eicosanoid enzymes, distinct from neighbours on mevalonate/lanosterol synthesis and bile acid or spastic paraplegia defects.

name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase and glycine cleavage complexes
rationale: Members share protein lipoylation and the DLD-containing OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage complexes, unlike neighbours on BCKDH/PDH, GABA metabolism or the wider TCA cycle.

qualifier: mono- and dimethylation of non-histone proteins such as TP53
name: Peptidyl-lysine mono- and dimethylation including TP53 regulation
rationale: All members concern lysine mono/dimethylation, with p53 regulation marking non-histone targets, unlike neighbours on histone methylation complexes, acetylation and DNA methylation.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation and termination
rationale: Members are mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination and ribosome quality control, distinct from neighbours on tRNA aminoacylation, mtDNA replication and mitochondrial RNA processing or ribosome assembly.

name: Post-Golgi and endosomal trafficking with membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi vesicle budding, constitutive secretion, Golgi-to-endosome and endocytic transport with membrane tubulation and Golgi positioning, unlike neighbours on COPI/Golgi-ER retrograde traffic, Golgi organization and endosome-to-Golgi retrieval.

name: Thymic T cell differentiation and lymphocyte development
rationale: Members concern T cell (thymocyte, CD8, gamma-delta) differentiation and activation with general lymphocyte development modules, distinct from B cell lineage/germinal centre and IL2/TCR network neighbours.

qualifier: electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
name: Mitochondrial respiratory electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
rationale: All members describe operation of the respiratory chain and ATP synthesis, unlike neighbours on respiratory complex assembly, membrane insertion and mitochondrial translation.

name: TCA cycle isocitrate-2-oxoglutarate metabolism and NADPH regeneration
rationale: Members cover TCA intermediates isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate and malate with NADPH regeneration and 2-hydroxyglutarate formation, distinct from neighbours on the malate-aspartate shuttle, PDH/CoA and lipoylated dehydrogenase complexes.

name: tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging and wobble-base tRNA modifications, unlike neighbours on mitochondrial RNA processing, translation and tRNA methylation.
